items.title: 「続ポートピア連続殺人事件」「配信少女ノ裏垢迷宮」，新旧2作品を並べたジー・モードブースは大盛況。取締役・竹下功一氏に聞く［TGS2026］
items.summary: TGS2026のジー・モードブースでは，「続ポートピア連続殺人事件：忘却の埋葬」と「配信少女ノ裏垢迷宮」という新旧2本のADVが出展され，大きな賑わいを見せていた。自社単独でのTGS出展は今回が初となる同社。その取締役・竹下功一氏に，2作品の成り立ちやパブリッシャとしての取り組みについて話を聞いた。

zh.title: G-Mode展位展出了《Zoku Portopia连环杀人事件》和《电龙少女的里道迷宫》等新旧作品，获得了巨大成功。竹下浩一导演专访 [TGS2026]
zh.summary: 在TGS2026的G-Mode展位上，展出了《波托皮亚连环杀人事件续集：湮没的埋葬》和《电龙少女的里道迷宫》两款新旧ADV，大受欢迎。这将是该公司首次单独参展TGS。我们采访了其总监竹下浩一，了解了这两部作品的起源以及他作为出版商所做的努力。

en.title: The G-Mode booth, which displayed old and new works such as ``Zoku Portopia Serial Murder Case'' and ``Denryu Shoujo no Ura-Daku Labyrinth'', was a huge success. Interview with Director Koichi Takeshita [TGS2026]
en.summary: At the G-Mode booth at TGS2026, two old and new ADVs, ``Sequel to the Portopia Serial Murder Case: Burial of Oblivion'' and ``Denryu Shoujo no Ura-Daku Labyrinth'' were on display, and were very popular. This will be the first time for the company to exhibit at TGS on its own. We spoke to its director, Koichi Takeshita, about the origins of the two works and his efforts as a publisher.

items.title: Flydigiが最新ゲームパッド「APEX 6」シリーズを展示。綾波レイやゼンゼロなどとのコラボモデルも展開［TGS2026］
items.summary: ゲーマー向け周辺機器を手掛けるFlydigiのブースでは，9月中旬に海外市場へ向けて発表された新型ゲームパッド「APEX6」と「APEX6Pro」を展示していた。今回はAPEX6Proを中心にチェックしたので，前世代製品との違いを含めて特徴を紹介する。

zh.title: 飞智展出最新游戏手柄“APEX 6”系列。与 Rei Ayanami、Zenzero 等的合作型号也已推出 [TGS2026]
zh.summary: 在游戏周边产品飞智的展位上，他们展示了9月中旬向海外市场推出的新款游戏手柄“APEX6”和“APEX6Pro”。这次我们主要考察的是APEX6Pro，所以我们会介绍一下它的特点，包括与上一代产品的差异。

en.title: Flydigi exhibits its latest game pad "APEX 6" series. Collaboration models with Rei Ayanami, Zenzero, etc. are also available [TGS2026]
en.summary: At the booth of Flydigi, which handles peripherals for gamers, they were exhibiting the new game pads ``APEX6'' and ``APEX6Pro,'' which were announced for overseas markets in mid-September. This time we mainly checked the APEX6Pro, so we will introduce its features, including the differences from previous generation products.

items.title: “縛り”から創造された，そうだったかもしれない5つの時代。セガブースに出展された「STRANGER THAN HEAVEN」の見どころを，RGGスタジオのキーマンに聞いた［TGS2026］
items.summary: 「東京ゲームショウ2026」のセガブースでは，RGGスタジオが贈る新作「STRANGERTHANHEAVEN」が出展されている。試遊台でコンバット（戦闘）をいち早くプレイできるほか，盛りだくさんのコンテンツを展開するTGS2026のセガブースだが，それらの展示の狙いや，作品作りに対するこだわりなどをRGGスタジオのキーマンに聞いた。

zh.title: 可能因“束缚”而产生的五个时代。我们向RGG工作室的一位关键人物询问了世嘉展台上展出的《STRANGER THAN HEAVEN》的亮点[TGS2026]
zh.summary: 在“东京电玩展2026”的世嘉展台上，展出了RGG工作室推出的新作《STRANGERTHANHEAVEN》。 TGS2026 的 SEGA 展位将提供各种内容，包括能够在演示主机上快速进行战斗，我们向 RGG Studio 的一位关键人物询问了这些展品的目的以及他们在创作作品时所投入的承诺。

en.title: Five eras that may have been created from "binding". We asked a key person at RGG Studio about the highlights of "STRANGER THAN HEAVEN" exhibited at the Sega booth [TGS2026]
en.summary: At the Sega booth at "Tokyo Game Show 2026", the new work "STRANGERTHANHEAVEN" presented by RGG Studio is on display. The SEGA booth at TGS2026 will be offering a variety of content, including being able to quickly play combat on the demo console, and we asked a key person at RGG Studio about the purpose of these exhibits and the commitment they put into creating their works.

items.title: 2匹のペットが，飼い主をロープ代わりにして大冒険！ 「It Takes Paws」は，プレイヤー2人の協力が必須だ［TGS2026］

zh.title: 两只宠物以主人为绳索，踏上大冒险！ “It Takes Paws”需要两名玩家的合作 [TGS2026]
zh.summary: AwooStudio 的一款可玩的合作动作游戏《ItTakesPaws》在东京电玩展 2026 的 2PGames 展位上展出。这是一款需要团队合作的作品，两名玩家控制一只猫和一只狗，利用他们跛行的主人像绳子一样前进。

en.title: Two pets go on a big adventure using their owners as ropes! “It Takes Paws” requires the cooperation of two players [TGS2026]
en.summary: A playable cooperative action game "ItTakesPaws" by AwooStudio is on display at the 2PGames booth at Tokyo Game Show 2026. This is a work that requires teamwork, with two players controlling a cat and a dog, using their limp owners like ropes to advance.

en.summary: At the SELECTEDINDIE80 booth at Tokyo Game Show 2026, a new game ``DONUTPANIC'' by Kyle Banks, an individual developer living in Edinburgh, is on display. I've been playing a unique horror game by a developer who truly loves donut cooking.

en.title: Why does "The Memory Authority" have such great staying power?
en.summary: This summer is a summer worth recording in the history of Chinese animation, because "Memory Authority" is online. Even though quite some time has passed since the final episode on August 30, I can still feel the aftertaste left by the work, and I am very sure that it will echo for a long, long time... Because this is something created by human beings who burn their souls with all their strength, and it will inevitably release a powerful and lasting light. Go home, it is the glory of the human soul! ■ Domestic EVA In the process of enjoying "Memory Authority", it is difficult for me not to think of "Neon Genesis Evangelion" (hereinafter abbreviated as "EVA"). Even if we don’t mention the deliberate tribute Easter eggs or the extremely exaggerated picture performance like Unit 1 pushing the apostle to move the entire building, the story itself is very impressive, whether it is the crazy Riddler-style storytelling technique at the beginning, or the key scene "elevator" that appears many times, or the stream of consciousness like the third episode where you listen to headphones and sit on the bus and think about life.

In addition, there is also the third season of the battle pass "Era of Plague", which will bring the laboratory tactical map and a series of new exclusive rewards. The main content BlastGang is a 5v5 game mode played in a large map in the arena, inspired by the classic blasting gameplay. The attacker needs to plant the explosive device, and the defender must prevent the attacker from planting the device or defuse it before it detonates.
